decision: Retain all 14 active images after native-size review; no generation required.

images.title: Hosea's Marriage to Gomer
images.alt: Hosea and Gomer share a quiet courtyard meal with their three children.
images.review: Hosea and Gomer share a meal with two boys and one girl. Composite family scene after the three births; no exact child ages assigned. Brown complexions, dark natural curls, believable faces and cloth. Visible bread grips, fingers, arms and proportions show no definite defect; table and clothing obscure lower bodies. No other located named portrayal requires identity matching.

images.alt: Imagined scene: A rocky wilderness valley opens toward green vineyards.
images.review: Rocky wilderness opens into a green vineyard, with blue sky and natural foliage. Imagines restoration imagery, without identifying a literal valley location. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: Loose silver pieces lie beside an open sack of barley.
images.review: Loose unmarked silver pieces beside barley. No modern minted denominations or exact weight claim. Material textures and oblique light remain grounded. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: Dry earth and withered plants border a shrinking stream.
images.review: Cracked earth, shrinking stream and withered plants illustrate mourning land. Subdued daylight fits the drought imagery. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: A boundary stone tilts beside disturbed earth between two fields.
images.review: Tilted field-boundary stone beside disturbed earth illustrates removal of a boundary. Accepted v4 has no signature-like corner mark; rejected v1–v3 remain inactive. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: Rain falls on a green field as morning light breaks through mist.
images.review: Rain, mist and green shoots under emerging dawn light illustrate rain and morning imagery. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: A clay oven glows beside dough and a partly scorched flatbread.
images.review: Glowing clay oven, dough and partly burned bread illustrate the oven and unturned cake comparisons. Warm embers contrast with neutral daylight. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: Bare stalks bend in the wind beneath storm clouds.
images.review: Wind bends bare stalks under storm clouds. Imagines sowing wind and harvest failure without presenting a literal disaster record. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: An empty winepress stands beside a bare threshing floor.
images.review: Empty winepress and bare threshing floor illustrate failed yield. Weathered stone and natural light fit the style. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: Thorns and purple thistles grow around a stone altar.
images.review: Thorns and purple thistles overgrow a stone altar, matching the chapter imagery. No invented named portrait or exact shrine reconstruction. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: A wooden yoke lies beside fodder and loose cords.
images.review: Removed wooden yoke, cords and fodder illustrate agricultural compassion language without making Israel a literal child portrait. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: Clay oil jars and packing ropes stand beside a desert road.
images.review: Clay oil jars, packing rope and a road illustrate oil being carried to Egypt. Does not assign a face to Jacob, Moses or a king mentioned elsewhere in the chapter. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: Wind blows dust past a dry spring and brittle grass.
images.review: Dust blows past a dry spring and brittle grass, matching east-wind and dried-source imagery. No people or animals.

images.alt: Imagined scene: Dew covers lilies beside an olive tree, grain and vines.
images.review: Dewy lilies, olive tree, grain and vines visualize the restoration comparisons. Blue-green natural colors and restrained realistic detail remain compatible. No people or animals.
